newsitem.title: USA: Ohio 1,205 MW Perry nukes returns to full power.
newsitem.headline: Ohio 1,205 MW Perry nukes returns to full power.

text.p: The 1,205 megawatt Perry nuclear power plant in North Perry, Ohio, was operating at full power as of early Tuesday following a repair shutdown, the Nuclear Regulatory Commission (NRC) said.
The plant was shut one week ago to correct an electrical problem linked to the system that monitors feedwater levels.
Perry was operating at 100 percent of capacity as of early Tuesday, the NRC said in its daily plant status report.
The plant is operated and majority owned by Centerior Energy Corp, while Ohio Edison Co and DQE Inc also have interests in the plant.
